guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, cmd_q and cmd_buf_q are both set to CmdNone.
When reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe and cmd_update are both true, cmd_q is updated with the previous cmd_buf_q value, and cmd_buf_q is updated with the new command from reg2hw.cmd.cmd.q.
When reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe is true, cmd_update is false, and counting_q is low, cmd_q is directly assigned the new command from reg2hw.cmd.cmd.q.
When reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe is true, cmd_update is false, and counting_q is high, cmd_buf_q is assigned the new command from reg2hw.cmd.cmd.q, while cmd_q retains its current value.
When cmd_update is true and reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe is false, cmd_q is assigned the current cmd_buf_q, and cmd_buf_q is set to CmdNone.
When none of the above conditions are true (no reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe and no cmd_update), both cmd_q and cmd_buf_q hold their previous values.

assumptions.claim: cmd_update is a single-cycle pulse per expiration event. If it remains high for multiple consecutive cycles, a second cycle would assign cmd_q with the newly cleared cmd_buf_q (CmdNone), losing the active command.
assumptions.cond: cmd_update asserted for more than one clock cycle
assumptions.risk: Loss of active command due to spurious clear to CmdNone.

assumptions.claim: reg2hw.cmd.cmd.q must be limited to valid kmac_cmd_e enumerated values. The cast kmac_cmd_e'() does not check for out-of-range values.
assumptions.risk: An illegal command value could propagate to cmd_q/cmd_buf_q and bypass downstream security checks or cause undefined behavior.

assumptions.claim: cmd_update must be asserted only when cmd_buf_q holds a valid command intended for promotion, or when it is safe to clear cmd_q to CmdNone.
assumptions.risk: Spurious assertion of cmd_update when no command is buffered will overwrite cmd_q with CmdNone, potentially discarding an active command.

uncertain_points.claim: When counting_q=1, a second write (qe) will overwrite any previously buffered command in cmd_buf_q. The design intent for handling multiple writes while a command is already pending is unclear.
uncertain_points.cond: reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe && counting_q==1 while cmd_buf_q already holds a non-CmdNone value
uncertain_points.risk: Commands can be silently lost if software issues a new command before the previous buffered command is promoted.

uncertain_points.claim: The cast kmac_cmd_e'(reg2hw.cmd.cmd.q) does not include an in-range check. An illegal software write could produce an invalid enum that propagates to command execution, potentially bypassing cryptographic access controls.
uncertain_points.cond: reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe asserted with an out-of-range q value
uncertain_points.risk: Security bypass or unexpected behavior in KMAC command processing, possibly exposing keys or data.

uncertain_points.claim: When neither qe nor cmd_update is active, cmd_q retains its current value indefinitely. If the external logic stops generating cmd_update pulses, the active command may never be cleared or progressed, leading to a hang.
uncertain_points.cond: System stall where cmd_update ceases to be generated
uncertain_points.risk: Command pipeline could become permanently stuck, potentially blocking further operations.
